xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: SCILAL has no Independent Directors including Woman Independent Director on Board. Being a Government Company and as per AoA of the Company, power to appoint directors of SCILAL lies with competent authority and SCILAL is coordinating for same with authority. Shri Manjit Singh Saini has ceased to be director of SCILAL w.e.f. 01.02.2025 owing to his superannuation from the Board of SCI on 31.01.2025. Further MoPSW vide letter dated 24.02.2025 conveyed that the post of Director (Finance), SCILAL will be discontinued until further orders. Accordingly, Shri Atul Ubale has ceased to hold the post of Director (Finance), SCILAL w.e.f. 24.02.2025.
